reason: Both are pharma companies selling prescription drugs through wholesalers. Both have an iron product for iron deficiency anemia in chronic kidney disease. Akebia is a renal-focused brand owner with a few branded oral drugs, sold to dialysis providers and nephrologists, and it earns license revenue. Amphastar is mainly a manufacturer of generic and proprietary injectables, inhalers and nasal products, sold to hospitals, GPOs and wholesalers. The overlap is narrow (CKD iron), so this is adjacent rather than direct.
